summary: Sandbach United's pre-season is in full swing with a tough loss to St Helens last time out, but spirits are high as the 26/27 campaign kicks off in just one week. The Ramblers have bolstered their squad with several exciting new signings and a returning player, plus they're sporting three brand new kits for the upcoming season. The club is actively seeking sponsorship opportunities, so if you're interested in supporting the team, now's the perfect time to get involved!
